hooks.name: Enforce environment variable usage for paths
hooks.description: Block hardcoded paths, force use of $LOCAL_KLIMBO_DIR and other env variables

action.command:
cat << 'EOF'
# Check if command contains hardcoded paths to KILOMBO workspace
if echo "$1" | grep -qE "(KLIMBO-BUILD|/root/JOB-sda2/KLIMBO-SITE)"; then
  echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"⚠️  HARDCODED PATH DETECTED: This command contains /root/JOB-sda2/KLIMBO-SITE/KLIMBO-BUILD hardcoded path. Use $LOCAL_KLIMBO_DIR instead. See .kiro/steering/use-env-vars.md for correct syntax. Execute anyway?"}}'
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
EOF
